source.title: The Emergency Food Assistance Program (TEFAP) Self-Declaration Form

questions.label: Print Name
questions.note: Under "Required information"; by writing it the applicant self-declares the four statements above.

questions.label: Date
questions.note: The day the form is filled in; not a saved fact.

questions.label: Household member ages (18-59)
questions.note: Members 18 to 59; the profile counts adults 18-64, so this is unknown when anyone is 60-64. The page prints only "(18-59):" after the (0-17) box; the row name is added.

questions.label: Household member ages (60+)
questions.note: Members 60 and older; the profile counts seniors 65+. The page prints only "(60+):" after the (18-59) box; the row name is added.
